rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_String_Decoding {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common string decoding routine used by Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1071.001"
        weight = 10
    strings:
        $xoring_loop = { 8B 45 ?? 8B 4D ?? 31 C1 88 4D ?? } // Common xoring loop in beacon shellcode
        $rc4_setup = "RC4 KSA" fullword ascii
    condition:
        $xoring_loop or $rc4_setup
}
